author: reek
body: Seasonal content rotation that spans all games in the multiverse. Seasons are 3-month periods with unique themes, rewards, challenges, and cross-game events. A season might add new cards, new dungeon themes, new portal destinations, and a seasonal leaderboard that tracks performance across all planes simultaneously.

author: reek
body: Seasons create FOMO (stuff goes away), drive engagement (seasonal rewards), and keep the economy fresh (new items entering, old items becoming vintage). The seasonal pass is the primary recurring revenue driver alongside ManaCoin sales.
